decision.reason: [ev-4e830661fba0] says only that the write dedupe cache is deprecated in 3.0.0. It does not name the configuration key or Helm values path that turns the cache on. The proposed exposure condition depends on a top-level values key "write_dedupe_cache" and on a ConfigMap text-line pattern, and neither appears in the evidence, so the condition may flag the wrong environments or miss exposed ones. To decide, I need the PR #10736 diff or the upgrade guide, showing the exact Loki config path and any Helm chart values key for the write dedupe cache.
